name: RP Optical Lab
summary: RP Optical Lab Ltd. engages in the development, production, and marketing of optical and electro-optical products in Israel. The company offers short, mid, and long waved infrared lenses, special lenses, video engine for cooled thermal imaging systems, thermal imaging cameras, multi-sensor systems. It serves defense, homeland security, medical, and commercial markets. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Petah Tikva, Israel.
